from pyspark.sql import SparkSession
from pyspark.sql import functions as F
from pyspark.sql.types import *

storage = "adls1tcba"
bronze_path = (f"abfss://lakehouse@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/bronze/tomtom")
temp_path = (f"abfss://lakehouse@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/temp/tomtom")
silver_path = (f"abfss://lakehouse@{storage}.dfs.core.windows.net/silver/tomtom")

# Zona waktu pengambilan data dari nama file
spark.conf.set("spark.sql.session.timeZone", "UTC")

from notebookutils import mssparkutils
import re

files = mssparkutils.fs.ls(bronze_path)

json_files = [
    f for f in files
    if f.name.endswith(".json")
]

mssparkutils.fs.mkdirs(temp_path)

for file in json_files:
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[:]", "_", file.name)

    target_file = f"{temp_path}/{safe_name}"

    mssparkutils.fs.cp(
        file.path,
        target_file,
        True
    )

print("Jumlah file JSON:", len(json_files))
print("Proses penyalinan selesai.")

# Mengambil tanggal dan waktu dari nama file
df_flat = df_flat.withColumn(
    "observation_time",
    F.to_timestamp(
        F.regexp_extract(
            F.col("source_file"),
            r"tomtom_(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}T\d{2}_\d{2}_\d{2})",
            1
        ),
        "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH_mm_ss"
    )

df_flat = (
    df_flat
    .withColumn("current_speed", F.col("current_speed").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("free_flow_speed", F.col("free_flow_speed").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("current_travel_time", F.col("current_travel_time").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("free_flow_travel_time", F.col("free_flow_travel_time").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("confidence", F.col("confidence").cast("double"))
    .withColumn("road_closure", F.col("road_closure").cast("boolean"))
    .withColumn("version", F.col("version").cast("string"))
)

df_flat.printSchema()
display(df_flat.limit(5))

# Menghapus data yang tidak memiliki informasi penting
df_clean = df_flat.dropna(
    subset=[
        "frc",
        "current_speed",
        "free_flow_speed",
        "current_travel_time",
        "free_flow_travel_time",
        "confidence",
        "road_closure",
        "coordinates",
        "observation_time"
    ]
)

# Memastikan nilai numerik berada pada rentang yang valid
df_clean = df_clean.filter(
    (F.col("current_speed") >= 0) &
    (F.col("free_flow_speed") >= 0) &
    (F.col("current_travel_time") >= 0) &
    (F.col("free_flow_travel_time") >= 0) &
    (F.col("confidence").between(0, 1)) &
    F.col("confidence").between(0, 1) &
    (F.size(F.col("coordinates")) > 0)
)

# Memastikan koordinat tersedia
df_clean = df_clean.filter(F.size(F.col("coordinates")) > 0)

# Menghapus duplikasi data yang benar-benar identik
df_clean = df_clean.dropDuplicates()

print("Jumlah data setelah cleaning:", df_clean.count())
display(df_clean.limit(5))
bentuk DataFrame Silver dan cek hasil

df_silver = (
    df_clean
    .withColumn("processed_at", F.current_timestamp())
    .withColumn("source_system", F.lit("TomTom"))
)

df_silver.printSchema()
display(df_silver.limit(10))
display(cek_null(df_silver))
print("Jumlah data Silver:", df_silver.count())

df_silver_result = spark.read.parquet(silver_path)

print("Jumlah data Silver:", df_silver_result.count())

display(df_silver_result)
